lead.title: OpenAI ships GPT-Live full-duplex voice for ChatGPT, rebuilt in six months
lead.summary: OpenAI rolled out true full-duplex voice to ChatGPT Voice, letting the assistant listen and speak at the same time via a turnless speech model with a dedicated audio fast path and async reasoning. The overhaul cuts voice-session startup from six network round-trips to one, and the team detailed how they shipped it in just six months.

top_stories.title: Horizon3 hits $2B valuation with $250M Series E as AI threats escalate
top_stories.summary: The AI-powered continuous security validation startup closed a $250M Series E at a $2B valuation, riding rising demand as AI-driven cyber threats grow.

top_stories.title: Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max flagship coding model hits general availability
top_stories.summary: Qwen3.8-Max reached GA targeting long-horizon autonomous work and coding, with a 1,000,000-token context window (131K max output) priced at $2/$6 per million input/output tokens on OpenRouter.

top_stories.title: Benioff-backed June raises $20M pre-seed to solve AI deployment
top_stories.summary: A Marc Benioff-backed startup backed by Michael Dell, Aaron Levie and George Kurtz raised $20M pre-seed to help enterprises deploy AI across legacy systems.

items.title: WorldExam: a benchmark for world models from appearance to reactivity
items.summary: A hierarchical diagnostic benchmark spanning visual quality, control adherence, spatial consistency and world reactivity across 1,474 cases and eight tasks, unifying evaluation of camera-, action- and language-driven world-model paradigms.

items.title: Structured memory for edge LMs: O(1) SSM state injection kills KV-cache growth
items.summary: State-space models can eliminate both Transformer KV-cache growth and RAG prefill cost by injecting corpus state in O(1), enabling persistent context for edge deployment.

items.title: Self-improving LLMs via progressive experience evolution
items.summary: A mechanism that turns transient interaction experience into persistent model capabilities, addressing fragmentation across test-time and self-improvement methods.

items.title: Cooperative coevolution for memory-efficient agentic LLM post-training
items.summary: An evolution-strategies approach that does full-parameter post-training of tool-using agents without backpropagation, matching gradient-based performance at lower memory cost.

items.title: LEAP: critic-free code RL for GPU kernel generation
items.summary: An adaptive environment-feedback pruning method built on GRPO that bypasses critic-network memory overhead for reinforcement-learning-driven GPU kernel generation.

items.title: MiniMax-H3 open weights top the Video Arena: multimodal input, 2K/24fps output
items.summary: MiniMax released open weights for MiniMax-H3 (Hailuo 3.0), now the #1 open model in the Video Arena. It takes text, image, video and audio in one context and generates 5-15s clips at native 2K and 24fps with stereo audio, with day-0 local inference in SGLang Diffusion and vLLM-Omni.

items.title: Nous Research ships Hermes Agent v0.20.0 'The Herald Release'
items.summary: A major open-source agent framework update with a full changelog, demo video and easy `hermes update` path, drawing strong community engagement.

items.title: New paper extends RLVR to RLSVR for open-ended self-improvement
items.summary: A proposal to turn task transformation into self-verifiable reward signals, pushing reinforcement learning toward more open-ended, self-improving LLM training.

items.title: Reimagine Robotics exits stealth with robots that 'learn on the job'
items.summary: The embodied AI startup unveiled a robotics approach focused on systems that learn on the job rather than relying on pre-programmed task libraries.

items.title: ASUS UGen300: a $300 USB AI accelerator with 40 TOPS Hailo-10H
items.summary: ASUS launched the UGen300, a $299.99 USB AI accelerator built on the Hailo-10H chip (40 TOPS, 8GB LPDDR4) for on-device inference on laptops and edge systems.

items.title: HEBI Robotics wins NASA SBIR grant for miniaturized actuators
items.summary: A NASA SBIR Phase I award will accelerate HEBI's miniaturized actuator work, exploring packaging and high-performance motion for space and robotics through December 2026.

items.title: igus launches energy chain with 600° rotation for industrial robots
items.summary: The twisterchain energy chain delivers cable management with over 600° of rotation for palletizing and small industrial-robot applications on Axis 1.

items.title: Velokey: one Task API for Kling, Veo, Seedance and Sora
items.summary: A single API gateway unifying access to leading AI video models, letting developers switch models without rewriting integrations.

items.title: mpai turns Codex and Claude Code sessions into multiplayer
items.summary: An open-source terminal tool that turns existing Codex and Claude Code sessions into live multiplayer sessions with shared context over Tailscale.

items.title: Inventory: search every AI agent and IDE conversation locally
items.summary: A private, on-device index that searches across Cursor, Claude Code, Zed, Codex and Kiro conversations in one timeline, with no signup required.

items.title: Peek-CLI lets front-end agents see the browser
items.summary: A command-line tool giving front-end coding agents live visibility into rendered browser output while they work.

items.title: Aflabox raises €1.35M seed for AI-powered food safety detection
items.summary: The Italian agritech startup closed a €1.35M seed led by CDP Venture Capital for portable AI-based aflatoxin detection, with expansion planned in Kenya, Nigeria and Italy.

items.title: DigithON 2026 picks 100 startup finalists from a record ~500 applications
items.summary: Italy's largest digital startup marathon selected 100 finalists from a record ~500 applications to pitch before investors, corporates and institutions.
